method: Purposive, non-random primary-source storefront review; no gameplay sessions, sales evidence, or large-scale scraping.
metric_note: English and All are kept distinct. Counts and percentages are storefront snapshots, never unit sales, and may change. The scoring is relevance of stated mechanics for Lights Back On, not assessed UX quality.

rubric_scale.0: No relevant mechanic advertised / verified single-player for co-op axis
rubric_scale.4: Direct prominent overlap with the game's repair/cooperation/restoration goals
rubric_scale.null: No defensible evidence from the listing (never score absence of observation as failure)
